messages:
kyle: Terraform apply for release/2.1.0 tonight during change window 00:30-01:30 UTC. Scope: TGW route propagation changes, egress ACL tightening, cross-account IAM role (svc-inference) version bump. Need owners + rollback criteria.

infra-bot: terraform plan posted: https://ci.internal/runs/8923
Summary: 12 resources to add/update, 3 to delete. Plan-approved: no
Blockers: None flagged.

maria: I'll own TGW and routes. Plan looks ok. Will canary to us-west-2 first and monitor route propagation for 10m.

olivia: I'll own IAM. Note: we're pinning the iam module to tag v3.2.1 so we don't pull head during apply. Will not rotate svc-inference keys.

jack: I'll run the apply after canary passes. Command I'll use:
```
terraform apply -target=module.tgw -target=module.iam -auto-approve
```
Will run from cicd-runner-8.

sre-oncall: Rollback triggers:
- packet loss > 1% sustained > 5m
- p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline for 5m
- any Route53 propagation errors in healthchecks
If triggered, revert by applying revert plan (plan id 8922) and open pager.

kyle: Confirming change window -> 00:30 UTC. Canaries: us-west-2 primary, fallback eu-west-1 if issues. Maria/Olivia, post canary success msg before full apply.

deploy-bot: @here deployment scheduled: release/2.1.0 infra apply at 00:32 UTC. CI job: infra-apply-1775123456
Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/infra-apply-1775123456
Status: pending

maria: canary applied at 00:33 UTC. Routes propagated to 95% of attachments in 120s. No blackhole detected. Monitoring: normal.

olivia: IAM canary applied: role assumed ok by staging svc, cross-account trust verified. No policy denies.

jack: starting full apply now from runner. cmd: `terraform apply -auto-approve`

deploy-bot: infra-apply-1775123456 running
stdout:
 - module.tgw.aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route.update: Modifying...
 - module.iam.aws_iam_role.svc_inference: Updating policy...
apply completed: 12 added, 3 changed, 0 destroyed

infra-bot: post-apply checks:
- TGW route status: OK
- Egress ACLs enforced: sample checks passed
- IAM role propagate: OK
Outputs: tgw-route-table-id: rtb-0a1b2c3d

sre-oncall: Observability: p95 latency steady, error rate 0.3%. No alerts. :thumbsup:

kyle: Pin the module versions in root modules/versions.tf before next patch. Olivia, can you open a tiny PR to pin to v3.2.1?

olivia: Will do, PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1345
Title: pin/iam-module-v3.2.1
ETA: 30m

jack: Noted. Marking release notes: infra changes for 2.1.0: TGW routes, IAM trust update, egress ACL. Add rollback info.

kyle: Thanks everyone. Closing change window early since no issues. :tada:
